```yaml
name: Run Bun Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Setup local testnet
        run: |
          # Start local testnet in background
          bun run scripts/start-local-testnet.ts &
          TESTNET_PID=$!
          # Wait for testnet to be ready
          sleep 10
          # Check if testnet is running
          curl -f http://localhost:8080/v1/health || exit 1
          echo "TESTNET_PID=$TESTNET_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Bun tests
        run: |
          bun run test:ci

      - name: Cleanup testnet
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -n "${TESTNET_PID}" ]; then
            kill $TESTNET_PID || true
          fi
```
